reviewStatus.primary: accepted; exact source, checkpoints, restored rows and all 146 selected artifacts reviewed
reviewStatus.independentRawEvidence: accepted; seven checkpoints, 448 command receipts, ten archive readbacks, exact restored history/trust and three startups
reviewStatus.independentPublicReport: accepted; source/evidence projections, receipt ledgers and privacy verified

verdict: Original eight-attempt/48-event terminal journal archived and actually restored with exact rows and trust, then replaced by an explicitly provisioned zero-attempt batch; no product feature or capability promotion.
timeBoundary: Host command/read-completion timestamps differ from Android snapshot clocks. Sample spans are bounded observations, not continuous monitoring or latency.

initialFailure.correction: Toybox ps -A -n -o UID,PID,NAME; split each row with maxsplit=2, retaining numeric UID/PID checks and exact selected-user/package matching.

checkpoints.seedProvenance: Historical metadata copied unchanged; only attempts emptied. Not a new runtime observation.

commandTransport.mechanism: adb shell -T shell-v2; one quoted remote argv, actual remote status and distinct stdout/stderr
commandTransport.commandReceiptLedgerFormat: UTF-8 sorted numbered receipt basenames: basename TAB bytes TAB sha256 LF; SHA-256 over concatenated lines. Raw receipt contents remain private.

codecPreflight.scope: Actual compiled JVM parser/codec accepted exact original and six-field seed, preserved trust and historical process/revision/time, and rejected missing required metadata. Android storage/runtime tested separately.

seed.provenance: Externally provisioned bytes. Required process/revision/time copied from historical journal; these are not a new runtime observation.

stoppedReplacement.packageUserScope: Actual selected Android user checked against prior evidence; only this package/user force-stopped. Numeric UID/PID and device serial remain private.

privateFilePreservation.scope: Terminal/SSH/transfer configuration and keys, other-lane journals and earlier archives. No private credential/configuration contents or their digests are published.

scopeLimits: Diagnostic operator maintenance, not a product history-management feature.
No Connect action occurs in the reviewed controls and no new attempt appears; listener refusal is not packet-level proof of no attempted connection.
Full restored row equality covers events, details, identity and build provenance. Rewritten runtime envelope is intentionally not byte-identical to the archive.
Injected native taps do not qualify physical keyboard/mouse, native IME, accessibility, terminal bulk input or a TUI.
Same-filesystem rename/readback and sampled package absence do not establish power-loss durability, multi-file atomicity or absence of every system WebView process.
P0-S3 remains in progress; CAP-SSH and CAP-TERMINAL remain pending. Later operations in device-02 are outside this frozen evidence set.
